meta.authored_by: Claude Opus (illustrative draft, pending Ash authoring)

prompt: A parent object with new associated objects. Name the event, and the first action the governing procedure requires.
plot_description: Range from the parent against time for each associated object. Two pieces depart at a low, steady rate in the same direction and the count does not grow across subsequent sensor revisits.
accepted_first_actions: count the associated objects and characterise the growth
characterise how the count is growing
expert_cue: Two pieces, one direction, low energy, and a count that stops. A fragmentation spreads energy widely and the count keeps climbing as sensors work through it.
